name: seabirds-dive-log
description: SeaBirds native and web dive log

scripts.android:add: npm run sync:www && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run sync:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.windows:build: npm run sync:www && tauri build --bundles nsis
